package handler

import (
	domain "GENRE_MODULE/game/cardrpg"
	sender "GENRE_MODULE/game/handler/syncsender"
	"GENRE_MODULE/game/robotaccess"
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"context"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/gateway"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestCardRPGRobotBusiness(t *testing.T) {
	f := newCardFixture(t)
	auth := gateway.AuthenticatorFunc(func(_ context.Context, ticket string, _ net.Addr) (gateway.Principal, error) {
		switch ticket {
		case "owner":
			return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: f.players[0].ID(), SessionID: "owner", ServerID: 1}, nil
		case "outsider":
			return gateway.Principal{PlayerID: 999999, SessionID: "outsider", ServerID: 1}, nil
		default:
			return gateway.Principal{}, gateway.ErrUnauthenticated
		}
	})
	cfg := gateway.DefaultTCPConfig()
	cfg.Addr = "127.0.0.1:0"
	server, err := gateway.NewTCPServer(cfg, robotaccess.Dispatch(f.engine, f.rules), auth)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = server.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		if err := server.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	})
	run := func(ticket string, steps []bots.Step) {
		t.Helper()
		r := bots.Commands(runner.Config{Count: 1, Duration: 5 * time.Second, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: server.Addr().String()}}, func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(ticket), nil }, steps)
		if err := r.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if s := r.Stats(); s.Success != 1 || s.Failure != 0 || s.Canceled != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("robot: %+v", s)
		}
	}
	first := pb.PlayRequest{Seq: 1, Kind: "draw", Count: 10}
	second := first
	second.Seq++
	second.Count = 1
	invalid := second
	invalid.Seq++
	invalid.Kind = "not-a-command"
	run("owner", []bots.Step{{Request: first}, {Request: first}, {Request: first, Reconnect: true}, {Request: second}, {Request: second}, {Request: invalid, WantCode: 1}})
	if len(robotDecode(t, f.engine, f.players[0], f.players[0].Dao().GetState, domain.DecodeProfile).Draws) != 2 || robotDecode(t, f.engine, f.players[0], f.players[0].Dao().GetState, domain.DecodeProfile).Gems != 78 {
		t.Fatal("wrong committed business state")
	}
	before := robotRead(t, f.engine, f.players[0], func() string { return f.players[0].Dao().GetState() })
	run("outsider", []bots.Step{{Request: first, WantCode: 1}})
	if robotRead(t, f.engine, f.players[0], func() string { return f.players[0].Dao().GetState() }) != before {
		t.Fatal("unauthorized command changed authoritative state")
	}

	start := pb.PlayRequest{Seq: 1, Kind: "start", RoomID: f.runs[0].ID(), Count: 1}
	run("owner", []bots.Step{{Request: start}, {Request: start, Reconnect: true}})
	for range domain.MaxActions + 1 {
		view, e := sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine).Sync_CardBattle(context.Background(), f.runs[0].ID(), f.players[0].ID())
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		if view.Status != "running" {
			break
		}
		f.clock.Add(1)
		if view.Actor < 3 {
			action := pb.PlayRequest{Seq: view.NextSeq, Kind: "auto", RoomID: f.runs[0].ID()}
			run("owner", []bots.Step{{Request: action}, {Request: action}})
		} else if _, e = sender.NewCardRpgSender(f.engine).Sync_CardEnemy(context.Background(), f.runs[0].ID(), view.NextSeq); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	if robotDecode(t, f.engine, f.runs[0], f.runs[0].Dao().GetState, domain.DecodeBattle).State.Status != "won" {
		t.Fatal("battle not won")
	}
	claim := pb.PlayRequest{Kind: "claim", RoomID: f.runs[0].ID()}
	run("outsider", []bots.Step{{Request: claim, WantCode: 1}})
	run("owner", []bots.Step{{Request: claim}, {Request: claim, Reconnect: true}})
	if p := robotDecode(t, f.engine, f.players[0], f.players[0].Dao().GetState, domain.DecodeProfile); p.Wins != 1 || p.ActiveRun != 0 || p.Gold != 108 {
		t.Fatal("battle reward duplicated or missing")
	}

}
